meta.title: Apex Legends Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert any game's sensitivity to Apex Legends. Precise calculation using cm/360.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your Apex Legends mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Mouse/Keyboard → Mouse Sensitivity. Enter your FOV and ADS multiplier if relevant.
steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the game to convert to. Apex's faster movement means converted sensitivity might feel different — give it several matches to adjust.
steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value in your target game. Test in the firing range or practice mode before jumping into competitive matches.
desc: Convert any game's sensitivity to Apex Legends. Precise calculation using cm/360.
sensInvalid: Please enter a valid sensitivity (greater than 0)
dpiInvalid: Please enter a valid DPI (greater than 0)
